data.text: I’m in: 15 tons this harvest, with the full $15,000 donated to the clinic. My family taught me that caring for this lake means caring for the village that depends on it, too. I’ll also commit to no more than 6 tons next month, then 10 tons each once the lake is back at 100. Let’s keep these limits explicit and check our catches together each month so this exception stays an exception. John, will you commit to your share and the recovery limits? Luke, we’ll need your firm agreement to the 6-ton cap as well.
